title: Unit Event — Rekindle the Flame — Episode1 The New Everyday

meta.Event Outline: Having surpassed RAD WEEKEND, Vivid BAD SQUAD's next goal is to stand on top of the world. As each member strives to better themselves, something seems to be eating at Akito...

rows.Line: Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Regular A
rows.Line:
Whoa!
This place has been constantly packed ever since it reopened!

rows.Speaker: Regular B
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Even though a lot of time has passed since that event, it's incredibly busy!

rows.Speaker: Regular B
rows.Line: To be fair, this is where it all started for those kids, so tons of people flock here now. When it comes to RAD BLAST, this is like a place of pilgrimage.

rows.Speaker: Regular A
rows.Line: Not to mention that one of those legendary members works here.
Oh, are you guys talking about me?
se_walk_men_004_1

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Here's your usual blend!
I made it extra strong!

rows.Speaker: Regular A
rows.Line:
Oh, that smells nice.
Your barista skills have been getting better and better.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Well, I need to be good since Ken left me in charge. I'm not about to drag this place's name through the mud!

rows.Speaker: Regular B
rows.Line:
He really left you in charge...
I don't think any of us expected you to be named interim manager.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Haha. I'm just the manager in name only!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Other people are handling all the accounting and inventory. If anything, I'm more like a part-time worker.

rows.Speaker: Regular A
rows.Line:
Still, you should be proud.
In a way, you're Ken's chosen one!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Hehe...
Yeah, I was also pretty surprised when he asked me to take over.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: When I told him that I was looking for a line of work that would let me keep singing, he said, “Why don't you work here?”

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: What he said then made me really happy...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: He told me, “I want to keep this place open for anyone who wants to follow in you guys' footsteps,” and said I was the perfect person to trust with it.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: After hearing that, I had to accept his offer. Unfortunately, I can't serve any alcohol and stuff yet, so I can't operate during the same hours that Ken did...

rows.Speaker: Regular B
rows.Line: I see... Ken said all that?

rows.Speaker: Regular A
rows.Line: When we heard the news that Ken would be teaming back up with Taiga, we really thought he'd be packing up shop for good...

rows.Speaker: Regular A
rows.Line: Which is why we're so happy that we get to have coffee here again.

rows.Speaker: Regular B
rows.Line: Yeah, so keep up the good work, interim manager!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I will!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hello!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Hey, you guys!
I've got a free table over here!

rows.Speaker: Young Vivid Street Locals
rows.Line: Wait, aren't they...?!

rows.Speaker: Young Vivid Street Locals
rows.Line: Azusawa and Aoyagi from Vivid BAD SQUAD, right...?! Now I'm really glad we decided to wait here...!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Your usual blend and cafe au lait, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, thank you.
You seem very busy again today...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Yeah, because of my delicious coffee!
se_run_women_004_1
se_run_women_004_2

rows.Speaker: Young Vivid Street Locals
rows.Line: E-Excuse me!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Young Vivid Street Locals
rows.Line: Y-You're Azusawa and Aoyagi...from Vivid BAD SQUAD, right...?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, yes... That's us...

rows.Speaker: Young Vivid Street Locals
rows.Line: We're sorry about the sudden intrusion, but... W-We decided to learn to sing after seeing RAD BLAST...

rows.Speaker: Young Vivid Street Locals
rows.Line: Would it be alright if we shook hands?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, if you really want to...!

rows.Speaker: Young Vivid Street Locals
rows.Line: Th-Thank you so much...!

rows.Speaker: Young Vivid Street Locals
rows.Line:
We're still really terrible...
But we're going to do our best as a team in order to become amazing singers like you guys...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's such a great thing to hear!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: My friends are the reason I've been able to keep singing, so I really understand your desire to do your best for your team.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So... I hope I get to hear you all sing in the future. In the meantime, let's all keep doing our best!

rows.Speaker: Young Vivid Street Locals
rows.Line: Th-Thank you...!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
You've gotta be kidding me!
Why didn't they talk to me like that?!

rows.Speaker: Regular B
rows.Line: Haha. Looks like your coffee wasn't what they were after!

rows.Speaker: Regular A
rows.Line: Still, they've really started to have that dignified air that says “celebrity”. You gotta work harder on your aura too!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Grr! Just wait, you guys!
My videos are gonna start getting more views than theirs and...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Wait, Toya...
That reminds me of the new song you posted yesterday! It was really good!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Ah, I'm glad to hear that you liked it.
The new sounds I tried using may've worked well.

rows.Speaker: Regular B
rows.Line:
I also gave it a listen!
It's my favorite out of the ones you've posted recently!

rows.Speaker: Regular A
rows.Line: More and more Vivid BAD SQUAD songs keep clearing a million views, and you've been posting one new track after another. You're really on fire!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
But we still have a lot of work left to do, so we can't rest on our laurels just yet.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Because our goal is to stand on top of the world.

rows.Speaker: Regular B
rows.Line:
The world, huh...?
It's a big dream, but it doesn't feel impossible when you talk about it, right?!

rows.Speaker: Regular A
rows.Line:
Haha! Yeah!
Speaking of which, what are the other two up to right now? What are they doing to take on the world?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: They're doing what they can as we speak. Actually, it's been quite a challenge for them...
English Class

rows.Speaker: English Teacher
rows.Line:
Alright, let's begin today's lesson by greeting one another!
How are you?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
...
I'm good...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Uh... Pretty good!

rows.Speaker: English Teacher
rows.Line: Okay, you're both able to provide smooth responses, let's try going a little further!

rows.Speaker: English Teacher
rows.Line: What did you do on your day off?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: W-Wait, I caught the first part... But what did he say at the end?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: On your something...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: W-Would you mind repeating that?!

rows.Speaker: English Teacher
rows.Line:
Okay.
What did you do on your day off?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wh-What?
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: English Teacher
rows.Line:
Okay, that's it for today's lesson!
Please make sure to finish the assignments I've given you by next time.

rows.Speaker: Akito & An
rows.Line: Thank you very much...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
My brain feels so full...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Same...
I feel like I just worked out a muscle I'd never used before...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I can pronounce everything perfectly while singing, but when it comes to an actual conversation...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Anyway, who cares about language as long as the person you're talking to understands how you feel?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I get what you mean...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But you saw how the others did in their class. If we don't get up to at least their level, then we aren't gonna stand a chance abroad...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Ugh... Yeah, true...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You're right...!
We have to figure out a way if we're really gonna stand on top of the world...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Let's do our best, Akito!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah...!
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I honestly didn't think that you guys would still be taking those English lessons. I was so sure that you'd bail after going a couple times!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Why would we do that?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Our goal is to stand on top of the world, so we need to start thinking about performing overseas. If we don't deal with this now, then we'll end up paying for it down the road.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Performing overseas, huh...?
I really can't see myself doing that...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: But do you guys know what you're all gonna do in the immediate future?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
No specifics yet...
But we have a rough idea.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Ideally, we wanna get noticed by a big label that's based overseas! Like what happened to Uncle Taiga and his team!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Some recent artists have been able to get their break by posting videos online, but that would involve quite a bit of luck. We need to somehow increase our odds of getting noticed.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But, we aren't really in a position to get noticed yet.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We still don't have the fame or skills to call ourselves a world-class team yet. For now, we're doing what we can to expand our foothold over here.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Oh, okay!

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: Wait, is that why the most recent songs you guys uploaded have English subtitles and descriptions...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, we felt that the best way for us to get people around the world to notice us is to post songs online...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But we realized that most people wouldn't understand what we were singing if we just uploaded everything as is. That's why we decided to start translating the lyrics and such.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Once we feel that we've established a firm foothold, we plan on participating in some events overseas. We actually have one in mind already.

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line:
Cool...!
It sounds like you've got all your bases covered!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I mean, we weren't kidding when we said that we're gonna stand on top of the world!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Right!
It's a big goal, but we plan on working towards it bit by bit...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, everyone, let's all keep doing our best!

rows.Speaker: Akito, Toya & An
rows.Line:
Yes!
Yeah!
